result.summary: Found 1 major issue: low-contrast text on the promotional banner makes it hard to read.

issues.description: The promotional banner '3 free deliveries for you' uses light-colored text on a very pale mint-green background, resulting in poor contrast and reduced readability.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner text or use a darker background/overlay to meet contrast guidelines (e.g., WCAG AA) and ensure the offer details are clearly readable.
